newsitem.title: UK: LME copper edges a little lower in late trade.
newsitem.headline: LME copper edges a little lower in late trade.

text.p: Copper dominate trading on the London Metal Exchange on Tuesday but eased lower during the evening session, traders said.
At 1900 GMT, the red metal was valued at $2,253/$2,258 versus a kerb close of $2,258, an advance of $54 from Monday after touching a six-month high touched earlier of $2,258.
Copper found support from a warehouse stock fall of 3,850 tonnes to 6-1/4 year lows of 90,050 tonnes.
But the market also attracted brisk business as traders sought to cover tight December dates.
Aluminium was little changed during evening trading having sniffed at the $1,540 resistance earlier. At 1900 GMT it was quoted at $1,537/$1,540.
